company.name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints

positions.title: Teacher Assistant/Grader
positions.description: Work with students to help them understand how to use PL/SQL in an Oracle environment. Help students analyze their code by finding errors which prevents them from running their program properly. Tutor students who need a one on one review of concepts taught in class. Run labs three times per week.

positions.title: Website Developer
positions.description: Developed the company's website on HTML. Incorporated external services for booking and payment. Coordinated with graphic designer for logos and flyers. Photographed and retouched images for use in website. Implemented the Google Business listing for the company.

positions.title: Commercial Mortgage Advisor
positions.description:
Provided clients with a wide variety of loan programs for commercial properties. Financing from $1MM to $100MM nationwide and financing on international commercial properties $1MM and up. 
Developed loan packages to assist clients in meeting their funding goals.
Coordinated with underwriter and lenders to help get loans approved.

positions.title: Professional Assistant
positions.description: Assisted real estate company by listing properties in MLS. Scheduled viewings and showed properties to clients. Managed company's website.

positions.title: Postal Worker
positions.description: Ensured international post was sorted and delivered in a timely and professional manner. Provided customer service to the diplomatic staff at the US Embassy in Chile. Earned the Franklin Award.

positions.title: Home Day Care Provider
positions.description: Provided child care services to military families. Offered a nurturing home environment that supported each child's development in a family setting. Followed stringent guidelines and passed all unscheduled inspections. Earned the Home Day Care Provider of the Year award.
